The '''father''' of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Edruu]] of the [[Doan Royal House]] was responsible for releasing embarrassing holos of his son. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] transmitted the holos across the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], hoping to teach his son humility.<ref name="PoF" />
